title: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-MOPD on four Sparks

On the MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL checkpoint, NCCL extended IPv4 GIDs, which the profile sets, prefilled 8K to 128K-token prompts 11-17% faster than with them off at an unchanged decode step rate (performance/records/images/dev-20260927-b12xcache-mimo-v26-20260927.md).
